title: Exploring the effects and mechanisms of Chinese yam in treating osteoporosis using network pharmacology analysis and biological validation.
authors: Huang, Zhirong; Zou, Liyi; Xie, Baocheng; Huang, Yayan; Pan, Chunyu; Ye, Xiaomei; Qin, Youfa; Li, Yongmei
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子动力学研究山药治疗骨质疏松的机制，虽涉及分子对接与MD，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chinese yam, a plant used in traditional medicine and food, shows promise for treating osteoporosis, but its exact mechanism of action remains unclear. In this study, employs network pharmacology, molecular dynamics simulation techniques, and in vitro and in vivo experiments were employed to investigate the potential mechanisms underlying the therapeutic effects of Chinese yam on osteoporosis. Our study indicates that Chinese yam primarily exerts its effects primarily through several of its active components including Phytocassane A, Batatasin II, Gibberellin, Dihydroquercetin, Garcinone D, and Diosgenin. Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment revealed that the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway and MAPK signaling pathway were enriched with multiple targets, including EGFR, SRC, IL-6, AKT1, and CTNNB1. The results from molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations revealed favourable binding stability of the target-compound complexes. Among them, Dihydroquercetin and Garcinone D demonstrated superior binding affinity for each target. In a zebrafish model demonstrated that Chinese yam extract effectively alleviated dexamethasone-induced inhibition of bone mineralization. We also found that Chinese yam extract increased alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity, upregulated the protein expression of runt-related transcription factor 2 (RUNX2) and osteocalcin (OCN), and promoted PI3K phosphorylation in MC3T3-E1 cells treated with dexamethasone, and these effects could be reversed by a PI3K inhibitor (LY294002). This study revealed the active components and mechanisms underlying the efficacy of Chinese yam in treating osteoporosis, providing a theoretical foundation and research data for its clinical application in osteoporosis therapy.
abstract_zh: 山药是一种用于传统医学和食品的植物，在治疗骨质疏松症方面显示出潜力，但其确切的作用机制仍不清楚。本研究采用网络药理学、分子动力学模拟技术以及体外和体内实验，探讨山药对骨质疏松症治疗效果的潜在机制。我们的研究表明，山药主要通过其几种活性成分发挥作用，包括Phytocassane A、Batatasin II、赤霉素、二氢槲皮素、Garcinone D和薯蓣皂苷。基因本体论（GO）富集分析和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集显示，PI3K/Akt信号通路和MAPK信号通路富集了多个靶点，包括EGFR、SRC、IL-6、AKT1和CTNNB1。分子对接和分子动力学模拟结果表明，靶点-化合物复合物具有良好的结合稳定性。其中，二氢槲皮素和Garcinone D对各靶点表现出优越的结合亲和力。在斑马鱼模型中，山药提取物有效缓解了地塞米松诱导的骨矿化抑制。我们还发现，山药提取物增加了碱性磷酸酶（ALP）活性，上调了runt相关转录因子2（RUNX2）和骨钙素（OCN）的蛋白表达，并促进了地塞米松处理的MC3T3-E1细胞中PI3K的磷酸化，而这些效应可被PI3K抑制剂（LY294002）逆转。本研究揭示了山药治疗骨质疏松症的活性成分和机制，为其在骨质疏松症治疗中的临床应用提供了理论基础和研究数据。
